title: Quest log
description: A compact right-panel view of the current goal, the exact tasks needing the person, active work, current advice, queued or dependency-blocked work, and one folded finished count. Every task, state, PR, summary, timestamp, and count comes from the work fold. advice is the only agentic field: at most three short, actionable entries shaped as {text, why, task_id?}. The page labels it as advice and hides it when its host write stamp is older than the work fold. No page is changed when this template ships; a person can inspect it through dashboard_preview before choosing whether to apply it, and the existing instance history can roll it back.

upkeep.means: one to three small current actions, each {text, why, task_id?}
upkeep.when: whenever the work board moves or the useful next action changes
upkeep.how: write only current actions; remove completed advice; call dashboard_fields first for the exact shape
